title: Portfolio Sampler: First-pass Scoping + Fidelity Checklist for Sales & CS Feature Bundles
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Problem: Sales and CS bundle multiple enterprise asks into tangled requests with uneven scope fidelity, which slows PM triage and causes rework. Goal: Create a lightweight 'Portfolio Sampler' process and checklist that allows a first-pass scoping of grouped enterprise feature asks within 48 hours of intake. Deliver a small artifact that Sales/CS can fill and that PMs use to 1) score priority, 2) estimate level-of-effort band, and 3) decide immediate next step (P0 intake, nurture, or decline). The sampler should require minimal CS time, preserve signal for engineering-level decomposition, and create a consistent handoff artifact for epic creation or backlog grooming.
tasks: Interview 6 CS/Sales reps to surface common information gaps
Create a 5-point scoring rubric for value, feasibility, and alignment
Pilot with two account managers on 8 active enterprise asks
Incorporate pilot feedback and finalize rollout template
Add a small intake form in Salesforce/Notion and update CS playbook
Prepare PM triage playbook and decision thresholds
acceptance_criteria: Sampler template captures: customer context, affected product surface, user story, success metric, desired timeline, blockers, legal/SOC considerations, and supporting assets
Scoring rubric yields consistent priority buckets (Immediate / Shortlist / Nurture / Decline) with example thresholds
Pilot completion: template used for at least 8 asks and PM triage decision documented for each
Average CS completion time for sampler <= 25 minutes
At least one tidy handoff created (Epic or backlog task) per prioritized ask
Playbook and intake form live in Confluence and linked in CS handbook

notes: Implementation guidance: keep the sampler form intentionally small (7-9 fields). Integrations: add automated link to existing tickets in Salesforce/Notion and include a field for 'estimated monthly token volume' where applicable. Measure success by time-to-decision and % of samplers that convert to prioritized backlog items. Follow-up: schedule retrospective after first 30 samplers to iterate on rubric thresholds. Linked artifacts: confluence draft, pilot spreadsheet, and one-pager for AMs.
